summary: Delivery audit of Kiln Pause Now (whole PRD, two rounds): AC-PAUSE-02 and AC-PAUSE-04 are fully built; AC-PAUSE-01, 03, 05 and 06 each miss a part. After a phase splits mid-session, Pause now names the launched phase rather than the leaf the running header names (header, phase-plan row, paused card and Resume label); an audit with no live target, such as a Codex audit, loses its round in the pause panel; and the session page shows a bare Pausing pill instead of the Pausing {activity} header beside the phases done. Phase 2 was added to build these.
